Flow.description: Guided screen flow that sets up how an outcome or programme is measured: it creates or reuses an Indicator Definition (with its Unit of Measure), assigns it to the chosen Outcome or Programme, and creates one Indicator Performance Period per reporting period with optional baseline and target values. Nothing is saved until the user selects Confirm — save setup on the Review screen; the records are then created by three subflows (Indicator_Setup_Create_Indicator_Definition, Indicator_Setup_Create_Indicator_Assignment and Indicator_Setup_Create_Performance_Periods) in a single transaction, and any failure or duplicate rolls back every record created in that step, so the setup is saved all or nothing. A new indicator name that is already used, or an existing indicator that is already assigned to the chosen record, is reported straight after the Define step; for an existing assignment the user can add new reporting periods to it, provided they do not overlap its existing periods.

fields.name: inpFirstPeriodStart
fields.fieldText: Start Date of First Reporting Period
fields.helpText: The start date of the first period. Later periods are worked out from this date.

fields.name: inpLastPeriodEnd
fields.fieldText: End Date of Last Reporting Period
fields.helpText: The end date of your last reporting period, e.g., 31 Dec. If it falls part-way through a period, the last period ends on this date.

validationRule.errorMessage: Enter an end date on or after the start date that creates no more than 50 reporting periods.

screens.description: Screen. Informational content only, no inputs; shown after Confirm when the new reporting periods overlap performance periods already on the existing assignment. Nothing has been saved. Previous returns to Review. (Back, Finish available, no Pause)
screens.name: scrPeriodsOverlap
screens.label: Reporting Periods Overlap

fields.name: dispPeriodsOverlap
fields.fieldText:
These dates overlap existing reporting periods


The Indicator Assignment {!frmExistingAssignmentNameDisplay} already has the performance periods below between {!inpFirstPeriodStart} and {!inpLastPeriodEnd}, so the new periods were not added. Nothing has been saved.


Each indicator assignment uses one set of reporting periods that don't overlap, so targets and results aren't counted twice in reports.


Press Previous to return to Review, then choose Edit reporting periods and pick dates that do not overlap these periods.

screens.description: Screen. Shows the setup and lets the user change the indicator and unit of measure before choosing Confirm — save setup, Edit reporting periods or Cancel. (no Back, Finish available, no Pause)
screens.name: scrReview
screens.label: Review Measurement Setup

fields.name: dispReviewEditHint
fields.fieldText:
Please review your setup below.


To make changes, edit the indicator and unit of measure below, then choose an action. Choose Edit reporting periods to enter the period values again, or Cancel to end without saving.

fields.name: dispReviewSummary
fields.fieldText:
• {!varAssignmentTypeLabel}: {!frmParentRecapName}
  • Reporting Frequency: {!inpFrequency}
  • Performance Period: {!inpFirstPeriodStart} to {!inpLastPeriodEnd}
  • Total Performance Periods Configured: {!varPeriodCounter}

fields.name: dispReviewAddToExistingNote
fields.fieldText: ℹ Adding reporting periods to the existing assignment {!frmExistingAssignmentNameDisplay}. No new indicator or assignment will be created.

fields.name: inpReviewIndicatorChoice
fields.helpText: Reuse an existing indicator or create a new one.

fields.name: inpReviewExistingIndicatorId
fields.helpText: Choose an Active indicator from your library.

fields.name: inpReviewIndicatorName
fields.helpText: e.g., "% of participants who secured employment within 6 months". Maximum 255 characters.

validationRule.errorMessage: Please enter a name of 255 characters or fewer.

fields.name: inpReviewIndicatorStatus
fields.helpText: Active indicators can be selected in future setups. Choose Planned if the indicator is not in use yet.

fields.name: inpReviewIndicatorDescription
fields.helpText: What does this indicator measure and how is it calculated? Maximum 1000 characters.

validationRule.errorMessage: Please enter a description of 1000 characters or fewer.

fields.name: inpReviewUOMChoice
fields.helpText: Choose an existing unit of measure or create a new one.

fields.name: inpReviewUOMId
fields.helpText: Select the unit used to measure this indicator, e.g., Percentage, Number or Currency.

fields.name: inpReviewNewUOMName
fields.helpText: e.g., "Percentage", "Number of people" or "GBP". Maximum 255 characters.

validationRule.errorMessage: Please enter a name of 255 characters or fewer.

fields.name: inpReviewNewUOMCode
fields.helpText: A short code for the unit, e.g., "PCT" or "GBP". Maximum 255 characters.

validationRule.errorMessage: Please enter a code of 255 characters or fewer.

fields.name: inpReviewNewUOMDescription
fields.helpText: e.g., "Share of participants, from 0 to 100". Maximum 255 characters.

validationRule.errorMessage: Please enter a description of 255 characters or fewer.

fields.name: inpReviewAction
fields.helpText: Confirm — save setup saves everything in one step. Edit reporting periods keeps your changes above, the frequency and the dates, and asks you to enter the period values again. Cancel ends without saving.

screens.description: Screen. Informational content only, no inputs. (no Back, Finish available, no Pause)
screens.name: scrWelcome
screens.label: Welcome to Indicator Setup

fields.name: dispWelcome
fields.fieldText:
Welcome to Indicator Setup

This guided setup helps you decide how you will measure progress towards your outcomes and programs.


You will:

  • Choose what you are measuring – an Outcome or a Program
  • Create a new Indicator Definition or select an existing one
  • Set up one or more reporting periods, each with an optional baseline and target


Before you start: make sure your outcomes are set up, for example with the Outcome Strategy Builder flow, and that your programs exist in this Salesforce environment.

subflows.description: Calls subflow Indicator_Setup_Create_Indicator_Assignment, which checks for an existing assignment of this indicator to the chosen Outcome or Programme, then creates the Indicator Assignment. Passes in: inAssignmentType, inIndicatorDefinitionId, inIndicatorName, inOutcomeId, inProgramId. Captures outputs: outDuplicateFound->varDuplicateFound, outIndicatorAssignmentId->varIAId, outSucceeded->varSubflowSucceeded, outErrorMessage->varSubflowErrorMessage. Error handling: Subflow elements do not support fault paths, so the subflow catches its own faults and returns outSucceeded and outErrorMessage; the following decision routes any failure to scrError, which displays the message.
subflows.name: subCreateIndicatorAssignment
subflows.label: Create Indicator Assignment

subflows.description: Calls subflow Indicator_Setup_Create_Indicator_Definition, which checks for an Indicator Definition with the same name, optionally creates a new Unit of Measure, then creates the Indicator Definition. Passes in: inCreateNewUnitOfMeasure, inIndicatorDescription, inIndicatorName, inIndicatorStatus, inNewUnitOfMeasureCode, inNewUnitOfMeasureDescription, inNewUnitOfMeasureName, inUnitOfMeasureId. Captures outputs: outDuplicateFound->varDuplicateFound, outIndicatorDefinitionId->varIndicatorDefId, outUnitOfMeasureId->varFinalUOMId, outSucceeded->varSubflowSucceeded, outErrorMessage->varSubflowErrorMessage. Error handling: Subflow elements do not support fault paths, so the subflow catches its own faults and returns outSucceeded and outErrorMessage; the following decision routes any failure to scrError, which displays the message.
subflows.name: subCreateIndicatorDefinition
subflows.label: Create Indicator Definition

subflows.description: Calls subflow Indicator_Setup_Create_Performance_Periods, which finds or creates a TimePeriod for each reporting period and creates the staged Indicator Performance Periods in bulk. Passes in: inFirstPeriodStart, inFrequency, inIndicatorAssignmentId, inIndicatorName, inLastPeriodEnd, inStagedPeriods. Captures outputs: outCreatedPeriodIds->colCreatedPeriodIds, outSucceeded->varSubflowSucceeded, outErrorMessage->varSubflowErrorMessage. Error handling: Subflow elements do not support fault paths, so the subflow catches its own faults and returns outSucceeded and outErrorMessage; the following decision routes any failure to scrError, which displays the message.
subflows.name: subCreatePerformancePeriods
subflows.label: Create Performance Periods
